sentence: Ur zmireɣ ara ad t-xedmeɣ mebla ma iɛawen-iyi kra n yiwen.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by Amazigh_Bedar (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: I can't do it without somebody's help.

usageExamples: Ur xdimeɣ ara akken ilaq deg ukayad n wassa.
